item.title: Message from McAfee
item.description:
<@&1091057811930230984>
*The warmth of Abah's Landing harkens! What tales will you tell? What rumors will you hear? What connections and friendships might you make? Find out as the city comes alive!*
> **Roleplayers Unlimited's** weekly Abah's Landing RP is starting in the courtyard of the **Hew's Mane tavern**! Feel free to stop by, or start your own RP scene in Abah's Landing! You can whisper ``@Nitewalker314`` for a port until <t:1792805400:t>. > -# Open vampires, werewolves, daedra, etc. should expect potentially hostile encounters in Abah's Landing.
